analysis.narrative:

📈 **Themes:** AI infrastructure and institutional adoption momentum; crypto regulatory clarity potential creating institutional inflows; policy uncertainty and real rate pressures limiting duration-sensitive assets; sector bifurcation between tech strength and banking/consumer weakness; retail participation decline reducing demand floor.

🎯 **Levels:** SPY ($691.66): Call Wall $750 (56k OI, dormant), Put Wall $630 (149k OI, dormant). Max Pain $685. Near resistance: $700 (52k OI, active), $680 support (125k OI, active).
